mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending confidence and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rise > 0.2pp, or the Rank IC for UNRATE change is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% annually indicates supply-side constraints, pressuring corporate margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO annual growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for INDPRO growth is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy that depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth is negative, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS growth is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.3% annually indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate investment and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for INDPRO growth is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400.0 thousand units signal housing market contraction, a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
